title: Fresnel Rim Lighting with Rotating Object and Particles
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a Fresnel rim lighting shader on a rotating torus knot with interactive particle effects.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 0, 5) looking at origin
- Dark background (0x0a0a1a)
- Add a subtle ambient light (intensity 0.2) and a point light at (5, 5, 5) with intensity 1.0
- Create a TorusKnot geometry (radius 1.2, tube 0.4, tubularSegments 128, radialSegments 32)
- Apply a custom ShaderMaterial with Fresnel rim lighting effect

FRESNEL SHADER:
- Vertex shader: pass world normal and view direction to fragment shader
- Fragment shader: compute Fresnel factor using dot(viewDir, normal) with formula: fresnelFactor = pow(1.0 - abs(dot(viewDir, normal)), fresnelPower)
- Base color: (0.05, 0.05, 0.15), Rim color: (0.2, 0.8, 1.0) cyan glow
- fresnelPower uniform starts at 3.0, adjustable from 1.0 to 8.0
- rimIntensity uniform starts at 1.5, adjustable from 0.0 to 5.0

ROTATION:
- Object auto-rotates: Y-axis at 0.5 rad/s, X-axis at 0.2 rad/s
- Rotation can be paused/resumed with spacebar
- Track total rotation in radians for both axes

PARTICLE SYSTEM:
- Create 500 particles using BufferGeometry with PointsMaterial (size 0.03, color matches rim color)
- Particles orbit the torus knot in a spherical shell (radius 2.0 to 3.5)
- Each particle has random orbital speed (0.1 to 0.5 rad/s) and random orbital plane
- Particle opacity pulses with sin(time * 2.0) mapped to range [0.3, 1.0]
- Particles can be toggled on/off with 'P' key

INTERACTIVE CONTROLS:
- Arrow Up/Down: increase/decrease fresnelPower by 0.5 (clamped 1.0-8.0)
- Arrow Left/Right: increase/decrease rimIntensity by 0.25 (clamped 0.0-5.0)
- Spacebar: toggle rotation pause
- 'P' key: toggle particles visibility
- 'R' key: reset all parameters to defaults
- Mouse click on canvas: spawn a burst of 20 extra particles at random positions that fade out over 2 seconds

HUD:
- Top-left overlay showing: Fresnel Power, Rim Intensity, Rotation (paused/active), Particles (on/off), Burst Count
- Update HUD every frame

STATE MANAGEMENT:
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
- fresnelPower: current fresnel power value (number)
- rimIntensity: current rim intensity value (number)
- rotationActive: boolean
- rotationY: cumulative Y rotation in radians (number)
- rotationX: cumulative X rotation in radians (number)
- particlesVisible: boolean
- particleCount: number of active particles (500 base + burst particles)
- burstCount: number of burst events triggered
- particleOpacity: current computed opacity (number)
- elapsedTime: total elapsed time in seconds (number)
- fps: current frames per second (number)
physics_constraints: Fresnel power must stay clamped [1.0, 8.0]. Rim intensity must stay clamped [0.0, 5.0]. Particle opacity must stay in [0.3, 1.0]. Rotation accumulates continuously when active. Burst particles must decay and be removed after 2 seconds. All numerical state values must be NaN-free.
